variants.name: Hampton corner sofa with adjustable back and storage on left side

details.designFeatures: Adjustable headrest|The manually adjustable headrest not only ensures individual comfort, but also adds a playful visual appearance.|Seat cushions|The seat cushions are made of a special two-layer foam on top of pocket springs. This makes the cushions stay in shape, reduces wrinkles and ensures a soft and comfortable look.|Storage solutions|Store books, magazines and the likes in the integrated storage solutions available in arm rests and the footstool.|Depth and support|The total depth of the seat is 107 cm meaning wide enough to sleep on. To ensure optimal support despite this deep seating area, a lumbar cushion and a scatter cushion are available in coordinated fabrics and leathers.|Stitching and details|You find nice sewing details such as cross stitching on the back cushions. The leather version has more cuts and stitching than the fabric version allowing for a different look depending on your choice of material.
details.importantFunctions: Adjustable back for different seating positions|Built-in storage in left armrest
details.productSpecification: Armrest: Top: 35 kg/m3 CA HR foam. details.designFeatures: Adjustable headrest|The manually adjustable headrest not only ensures individual comfort, but also adds a playful visual appearance.|Seat cushions|The seat cushions are made of a special two-layer foam on top of pocket springs. details.designFeatures: Low 'floating' look|Salamanca boasts generous proportions and soft curves that are accentuated by slim, discreet black tubular legs to create a low, 'floating' appearance.|Outstanding comfort|Salamanca is crafted with super soft seats that boast a unit depth of 112cm and are constructed with a foam core in two densities for maximum comfort.|Modular design|Designed to fit any layout, Salamanca is available in a variety of configurations and modules, including an open-ended unit with an angled design.|Moveable cushions|Salamanca is finished with moveable back cushions that create a cocooning look and allow for flexibility.|Customisable in over 120 ways|Salamanca is a fully upholstered sofa design that is customisable in a range of fabrics to suit your space and style.

name: Carmo motion sofa with resting unit

variants.name: Carmo motion sofa with resting unit

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

name: Reno footstool

details.designFeatures: Designed for comfort|The softly shaped armrests and ears add an elegant and inviting look to the living chair and ensures a comfortable seating comfort.|Crafted for comfort|Reno is constructed with two types of foam. This enables us to create the unique and beautiful design while providing great comfort.|Turn around|The swivel function allows you to turn the chair in different directions without getting up. The chair comes with different base options to make the chair fit in your interior.|Complete the experience|The matching footstool completes the look and the small slope ensures optimal relaxation. The footstool may even work as a spare seat.|A dynamic appearance|The chair presents a wrinkled and soft look that creates a vibrant and very inviting appearance.

Maximize every inch|

|Soft seat comfort|Two foam types are combined to create supportive yet soft comfort, while the back cushions include a bolster that can be positioned in different ways to find what feels best for you.|Complete the set|For additional storage, the matching footstool is designed with a spacious compartment to hide away duvets and pillows during the day.|Your chaise, your choice|Whether you prefer to stretch out on the left or the right, the Southampton’s chaise longue adapts to your space. details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

description: Carmo motion corner sofa
name: Carmo motion corner sofa

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

name: Imola armchair with swivel function

details.designFeatures: Craftsmanship|The core of Imola is made of moulded hard foam, enabling us to create unique shapes. The hard foam is then supplemented with another mould of soft foam to make the chair as comfortable as it is beautiful. The chair is then upholstered in your preferred fabric or leather. This is a very difficult and time consuming process that only a few highly trained upholsters are able to do.|Complete the experience|The matching footstool completes the look and the small slope ensures optimal relaxation. The footstool may even work as a spare seat.|Base options|The chair has two base options - wire legs and a swivel star base. Choose the swivel base to turn the chair around seamlessly or go with the wire legs for a beautiful completion of the design.|Organic shapes|The strict organic shapes combined with the moulded foam offer a unique and outstanding look. The high back gives the chair a voluminous look that underlines the uniqueness of the design while providing great head support.|Inspired by a tennis ball|Henrik Pedersen's inspiration for the chair came from a tennis ball. When you look at the side of the seat you clearly see the same shapes and lines as in the tennis ball while the stitching completes the look. Even the footstool maintains the same design expression.
details.productSpecification: Back: 54 kg/m3 high resilient moulded foam|Frame: 70 kg/m3 high resilient moulded foam with steel frame inside|Seat: 54 kg/m3 high resiliency moulded foam|Suspension: Hard foam

variants.name: Element bed, bed-mounted headboard, with slats, excl. mattress

details.designFeatures: Customise every feature|From designer bed frame to headboard, fabric to finish, Element allows you to create a bed that is tailored to you, your style and your space requirements.|3-step customisation|Simply choose your bed frame, select your preferred headboard style and whether it's mounted to the wall or bed. Finish with a choice of legs and materials. With this intuitive approach, you can create a bedroom that’s beautifully cohesive and completely your own.|Smart storage solutions|Element is designed to help you declutter and stay organised with optional integrated storage. Perfect for modern life, this is a suite of storage beds that delivers on style without sacrificing function.|Redefining Scandinavian design|Whether you're drawn to a minimalist Scandinavian look or a more luxurious metropolitan vibe, Element takes Scandinavian design principles that evoke calm and reimagines them in a customisable way – creating a bedroom that's uniquely tailored to you.|Flexible by design|Element offers flexibility across all budgets, with options that reflect both pared-back minimalism and elevated luxury. With finishes in Natural Oak, Dark Oak, and Ash Grey, plus fabric and leather options to suit a wide range of interiors and lifestyles.

details.designFeatures: Low 'floating' look|Salamanca boasts generous proportions and soft curves that are accentuated by slim, discreet black tubular legs to create a low, 'floating' appearance.|Outstanding comfort|Salamanca is crafted with super soft seats that boast a unit depth of 112cm and are constructed with a foam core in two densities for maximum comfort.|Modular design|Designed to fit any layout, Salamanca is available in a variety of configurations and modules, including an open-ended unit with an angled design.|Moveable cushions|Salamanca is finished with moveable back cushions that create a cocooning look and allow for flexibility.|Customisable in over 120 ways|Salamanca is a fully upholstered sofa design that is customisable in a range of fabrics to suit your space and style.

details.designFeatures: Customise every feature|From designer bed frame to headboard, fabric to finish, Element allows you to create a bed that is tailored to you, your style and your space requirements.|3-step customisation|Simply choose your bed frame, select your preferred headboard style and whether it's mounted to the wall or bed. Finish with a choice of legs and materials. With this intuitive approach, you can create a bedroom that’s beautifully cohesive and completely your own.|Smart storage solutions|Element is designed to help you declutter and stay organised with optional integrated storage. Perfect for modern life, this is a suite of storage beds that delivers on style without sacrificing function.|Redefining Scandinavian design|Whether you're drawn to a minimalist Scandinavian look or a more luxurious metropolitan vibe, Element takes Scandinavian design principles that evoke calm and reimagines them in a customisable way – creating a bedroom that's uniquely tailored to you.|Flexible by design|Element offers flexibility across all budgets, with options that reflect both pared-back minimalism and elevated luxury. With finishes in Natural Oak, Dark Oak, and Ash Grey, plus fabric and leather options to suit a wide range of interiors and lifestyles.

variants.name: Carmo open end sofa, angled, right

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Inspired by the Japanese art form of binding|Nawabari was inspired by the Japanese art form of binding with ropes to forge close bonds. description: Bolzano 2.5-seater
name: Bolzano 2.5-seater

details.designFeatures: Organic shapes|The Bolzano sofa is made up of organic shapes and curved lines, encouraging togetherness and creating a sense of comfort in the home.|Elegant Silhouette|With a refined, round silhouette, the lines of the Bolzano sofa are clean and minimalistic for a contemporary and streamlined look that will never go out of style.|360° Curve|Complemented by a rounded armrest that continues throughout the back, the Bolzano sofa is crafted with a curved front panel that offers a 360° curve all the way around.|Considered details|The Bolzano sofa is finished with considered detailing, such as a ‘pulled in’ stitching detail on the rear that adds character to the design.|Invisible legs|Complete with discreet, ‘invisible’ legs, the Bolzano sofa has a low and floating appearance.|Superior seating comfort|The Bolzano sofa does not compromise on comfort with the perfect foam to frame ratio for all-day lounging.

Visit us in store and try for yourself.|Elegance|With the tasteful and refined frame, Augusta exudes a class and sophistication that will bring an airy elegance to the dining room.|Construction as design|The table top is placed on a beautiful black frame with aluminium details as a finishing touch on the leg. name: Ottawa dining chair

details.designFeatures: Leaf shape|The leaf shaped back underlines Karim Rashid´s dedication to nature. This feature makes the chair stand out as an iconic dining chair.|Leg design|The four pod leg design in different materials is an untraditional construction that gives the chair a refined and unique look. Also available with a wooden frame, the leg designs highlight the natural look of the seat.|A coordinated expression|The chair fits most dining areas, but works especially great with the Ottawa dining table and sideboard.|Customizable comfort|The foam seat is made of high quality moulded foam that allows the curved design to fit your body shape while allowing you to customize the chair in your selected fabric or leather. The chair is also available in a plastic version that offers great comfort and easy maintenance.

description: Aarhus 3-seater sofa
name: Aarhus 3-seater sofa

details.designFeatures: Timeless Danish design|Through a sleek and slender wooden frame, the Aarhus 3 seater sofa evokes the simplicity and functionality that defines Danish design. With rounded trims mirrored in the leg shape, this is a timeless expression of Scandinavian style.|Circular design principles|Created to last and adapt, the Aarhus 3 seater sofa is built on circular design principles. Every component is designed to be repaired, replaced, or recycled, extending the product’s lifecycle while reducing waste.|Nordic Swan Ecolabel|The Aarhus sofa is certified with the Nordic Swan Ecolabel, meeting some of the most rigorous environmental standards in the world. It evaluates a product’s entire life cycle – from raw materials to production, use, and disposal.|Materially minded|Upholstered in OEKO-TEX® certified fabrics, the Aarhus sofa is built from materials selected for their comfort, durability, and everyday practicality.|Engineered for comfort|The Aarhus sofa has a refined mid-century silhouette created by a solid wooden frame and traditional steel springs that deliver uniform and long-lasting comfort.
details.productSpecification: Armrest: Plywood, Inside 25kg/m3 foam, Outside 25kg/m3 foam, Top 30kg/m3 foam, Fibre fill|Back: Nozag spring, Pocket springs, 23 kg/m3 foam, fibre fill|Frame: Solid pine, particle board, plywood, metal frame, 16 kg/m3 polyurethane foam|Seat: Pocket springs, HR foam 30 kg, 30 kg/m3 foam, 25 kg/m3 foam, fiber fill|Suspension: Nozag springs|Fabric lining: Fibertex shirting

description: Imola armchair
name: Imola armchair

details.designFeatures: Craftsmanship|The core of Imola is made of moulded hard foam, enabling us to create unique shapes. The hard foam is then supplemented with another mould of soft foam to make the chair as comfortable as it is beautiful. The chair is then upholstered in your preferred fabric or leather. This is a very difficult and time consuming process that only a few highly trained upholsters are able to do.|Complete the experience|The matching footstool completes the look and the small slope ensures optimal relaxation. The footstool may even work as a spare seat.|Base options|The chair has two base options - wire legs and a swivel star base. Choose the swivel base to turn the chair around seamlessly or go with the wire legs for a beautiful completion of the design.|Organic shapes|The strict organic shapes combined with the moulded foam offer a unique and outstanding look. The high back gives the chair a voluminous look that underlines the uniqueness of the design while providing great head support.|Inspired by a tennis ball|Henrik Pedersen's inspiration for the chair came from a tennis ball. When you look at the side of the seat you clearly see the same shapes and lines as in the tennis ball while the stitching completes the look. Even the footstool maintains the same design expression.
details.productSpecification: Frame: 70 kg/m3 high resilient moulded foam with steel frame inside|Suspension: Hard foam

name: Ø lounge chair

details.designFeatures: Curved, oversized shape|The Ø’s striking curved and oversized design creates a sculptural silhouette that commands attention. Inspired by the natural contours of Danish islands, the chair’s form is both visually captivating and physically comforting.|An island of comfort|Ø is designed for deep comfort. Its enveloping shape and generous proportions deliver a lounging experience that feels as restorative as it is luxurious.|Plush cushions and choice of super-soft fabrics|With three plush cushions and tactile upholstery options, Ø offers a multi-sensory experience with the feeling of being enveloped in a soft embrace.|An exclusive statement piece|With its oversized, welcoming form and three soft back cushions, Ø can be a personal sanctuary for rest or an enveloping love seat for spending time with your nearest and dearest.|Helena’s personal connection|The name Ø – Danish for ‘island’ – carries a deep emotional resonance. Helena Christensen, born on an island, imbues this piece with her own connection to water and nature: “Our love seat is like a cosy little island in your home.”

description: Aarhus 2,5-seater sofa
name: Aarhus 2,5-seater sofa

details.designFeatures: Timeless Danish design|Through a sleek and slender wooden frame, the Aarhus 2.5 seater sofa evokes the simplicity and functionality that defines Danish design. With rounded trims mirrored in the leg shape, this is a timeless expression of Scandinavian style.|Circular design principles|Created to last and adapt, the Aarhus 2.5 seater sofa is built on circular design principles. Every component is designed to be repaired, replaced, or recycled, extending the product’s lifecycle while reducing waste.|Nordic Swan Ecolabel|The Aarhus sofa is certified with the Nordic Swan Ecolabel, meeting some of the most rigorous environmental standards in the world. It evaluates a product’s entire life cycle – from raw materials to production, use, and disposal.|Materially minded|Upholstered in OEKO-TEX® certified fabrics, the Aarhus sofa is built from materials selected for their comfort, durability, and everyday practicality.|Engineered for comfort|The Aarhus sofa has a refined mid-century silhouette created by a solid wooden frame and traditional steel springs that deliver uniform and long-lasting comfort.
details.productSpecification: Armrest: Plywood, Inside 25kg/m3 foam, Outside 25kg/m3 foam, Top 30kg/m3 foam, Fibre fill|Back: Nozag spring, Pocket springs, 23 kg/m3 foam, fibre fill|Frame: Solid pine, particle board, plywood, metal frame, 16 kg/m3 polyurethane foam|Seat: Pocket springs, HR foam 30 kg, 30 kg/m3 foam, 25 kg/m3 foam, fiber fill|Suspension: Nozag springs|Fabric lining: Fibertex shirting

details.designFeatures: Timeless Danish design|Through a sleek and slender wooden frame, the Aarhus 2.5 seater sofa with chaise longue evokes the simplicity and functionality that defines Danish design. name: Imola footstool

details.designFeatures: Craftsmanship|The core of Imola is made of moulded hard foam, enabling us to create unique shapes. The hard foam is then supplemented with another mould of soft foam to make the chair as comfortable as it is beautiful. The chair is then upholstered in your preferred fabric or leather. This is a very difficult and time consuming process that only a few highly trained upholsters are able to do.|Complete the experience|The matching footstool completes the look and the small slope ensures optimal relaxation. The footstool may even work as a spare seat.|Base options|The chair has two base options - wire legs and a swivel star base. Choose the swivel base to turn the chair around seamlessly or go with the wire legs for a beautiful completion of the design.|Organic shapes|The strict organic shapes combined with the moulded foam offer a unique and outstanding look. The high back gives the chair a voluminous look that underlines the uniqueness of the design while providing great head support.|Inspired by a tennis ball|Henrik Pedersen's inspiration for the chair came from a tennis ball. When you look at the side of the seat you clearly see the same shapes and lines as in the tennis ball while the stitching completes the look. Even the footstool maintains the same design expression.
details.importantFunctions: With swivel function
details.productSpecification: Suspension: Hard foam

name: Hampton sofa with adjustable back and resting unit left side

variants.name: Hampton sofa with adjustable back and resting unit left side

details.designFeatures: Adjustable headrest|The manually adjustable headrest not only ensures individual comfort, but also adds a playful visual appearance.|Seat cushions|The seat cushions are made of a special two-layer foam on top of pocket springs. This makes the cushions stay in shape, reduces wrinkles and ensures a soft and comfortable look.|Storage solutions|Store books, magazines and the likes in the integrated storage solutions available in arm rests and the footstool.|Depth and support|The total depth of the seat is 107 cm meaning wide enough to sleep on. To ensure optimal support despite this deep seating area, a lumbar cushion and a scatter cushion are available in coordinated fabrics and leathers.|Stitching and details|You find nice sewing details such as cross stitching on the back cushions. The leather version has more cuts and stitching than the fabric version allowing for a different look depending on your choice of material.
details.importantFunctions: Adjustable back for different seating positions

name: Imola footstool

details.designFeatures: Craftsmanship|The core of Imola is made of moulded hard foam, enabling us to create unique shapes. The hard foam is then supplemented with another mould of soft foam to make the chair as comfortable as it is beautiful. The chair is then upholstered in your preferred fabric or leather. This is a very difficult and time consuming process that only a few highly trained upholsters are able to do.|Complete the experience|The matching footstool completes the look and the small slope ensures optimal relaxation. The footstool may even work as a spare seat.|Base options|The chair has two base options - wire legs and a swivel star base. Choose the swivel base to turn the chair around seamlessly or go with the wire legs for a beautiful completion of the design.|Organic shapes|The strict organic shapes combined with the moulded foam offer a unique and outstanding look. The high back gives the chair a voluminous look that underlines the uniqueness of the design while providing great head support.|Inspired by a tennis ball|Henrik Pedersen's inspiration for the chair came from a tennis ball. When you look at the side of the seat you clearly see the same shapes and lines as in the tennis ball while the stitching completes the look. Even the footstool maintains the same design expression.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.

details.designFeatures: Timeless Danish design|Through a sleek and slender wooden frame, the Aarhus pouffe evokes the simplicity and functionality that defines Danish design. details.designFeatures: Adjustable headrest|The manually adjustable headrest not only ensures individual comfort, but also adds a playful visual appearance.|Seat cushions|The seat cushions are made of a special two-layer foam on top of pocket springs. variants.name: Hampton sofa with adjustable back, resting unit and storage left side

details.designFeatures: Adjustable headrest|The manually adjustable headrest not only ensures individual comfort, but also adds a playful visual appearance.|Seat cushions|The seat cushions are made of a special two-layer foam on top of pocket springs. This makes the cushions stay in shape, reduces wrinkles and ensures a soft and comfortable look.|Storage solutions|Store books, magazines and the likes in the integrated storage solutions available in arm rests and the footstool.|Depth and support|The total depth of the seat is 107 cm meaning wide enough to sleep on. To ensure optimal support despite this deep seating area, a lumbar cushion and a scatter cushion are available in coordinated fabrics and leathers.|Stitching and details|You find nice sewing details such as cross stitching on the back cushions. The leather version has more cuts and stitching than the fabric version allowing for a different look depending on your choice of material.
details.importantFunctions: Adjustable back for different seating positions|Built-in storage in left armrest|The loose cushions can be re-arranged for a different look or seating comfort

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. variants.name: Hampton sofa with adjustable back and lounging unit right side, armrest left

details.designFeatures: Adjustable headrest|The manually adjustable headrest not only ensures individual comfort, but also adds a playful visual appearance.|Seat cushions|The seat cushions are made of a special two-layer foam on top of pocket springs. This makes the cushions stay in shape, reduces wrinkles and ensures a soft and comfortable look.|Storage solutions|Store books, magazines and the likes in the integrated storage solutions available in arm rests and the footstool.|Depth and support|The total depth of the seat is 107 cm meaning wide enough to sleep on. To ensure optimal support despite this deep seating area, a lumbar cushion and a scatter cushion are available in coordinated fabrics and leathers.|Stitching and details|You find nice sewing details such as cross stitching on the back cushions. The leather version has more cuts and stitching than the fabric version allowing for a different look depending on your choice of material.

details.designFeatures: Low 'floating' look|Salamanca boasts generous proportions and soft curves that are accentuated by slim, discreet black tubular legs to create a low, 'floating' appearance.|Outstanding comfort|Salamanca is crafted with super soft seats that boast a unit depth of 112cm and are constructed with a foam core in two densities for maximum comfort.|Modular design|Designed to fit any layout, Salamanca is available in a variety of configurations and modules, including an open-ended unit with an angled design.|Moveable cushions|Salamanca is finished with moveable back cushions that create a cocooning look and allow for flexibility.|Customisable in over 120 ways|Salamanca is a fully upholstered sofa design that is customisable in a range of fabrics to suit your space and style.

details.designFeatures: Soft all around|The inside frame of the arm and backrest is cut out and covered with soft foam. This makes both the armrest and the backrest very soft and optimizes your comfort.|Modular|Carmo is a modular sofa system that can be bought as single modules. When doing so, the modules come fully upholstered with crocodile connectors ensuring easy attachment and detachment.|Oversized piping|Designer Anders Nørgaard has used oversized piping to define the unique, squared shapes and give a very soft and cocooning look.|Low comfortable back|The low comfortable back has the same height as the armrest giving a fantastic seating comfort, especially in the corner.|Invisible legs|With a height of only 5 cm, the legs seem invisible making the sofa look almost floating. This adds a visual lightness to the design.
